title: The Backrooms: Found Footage
description: A realistic, multiplayer-compatible, mind bending backrooms mod with infinite replayability.
body:
**WARNING: THIS MOD IS IN AN ALPHA STATE, MANY BUGS AND GLITCHES ARE PRESENT.**

If you came from CurseForge, thanks for taking the extra time to support development of the mod, it means a lot :3

There's not much content yet, and a lot of bugs n stuff is here because I haven't gotten around to really fleshing out the mod as I haven't even finished Level 0 or any of the base features that will be present by the full release or even a full beta.


The Backrooms found you. And it won't let you go.

This mod is a psychological horror mod based around the popular internet subject, The Backrooms. It has a few level that are listed below, with unique AI, animations, and models.

Level 0.
An oddly familiar endless yellow maze. You may be lonely, but you are not alone. This level has a terrifying entity called the Lifeform, a gangly tall creature that will stop at nothing to find you and kill you.

The Habitable zone: An infinite space resembling a garage, filled with Smilers and Hounds. If the lights go out and you're in the open, then you best pray.

Level Fun: A childhood party room, a place you could remember being with your friends eating pizza years ago(or days ago, i'm not judging). However, there's something here and it's not a mascot: The Partygoers. These aggressive entities alert their friends if they find you with a twisted version of many popular nursery rhyme songs.

Level Fun+: Like level fun, but with even more creatures like the Party Creators. However, you have a saving grace: After the Great Fun War, the Partypoopers were assumed to be killed. However, some survived and if you find one it will safely guide you away from the creatures that haunt this level.
